rationale: Class 2 within-row adjudication. The raw schedule rows identify the exact securities by issuer and interest rate, and the maturity column shows 02/13/2026 for the Federal Home Loan Bank Discount Note and 02/03/2026 for the U.S. Treasury Bill. Those dates match the XBRL residual values in the flag, while Agent A's parsed identifier dates are 2026-12-13 and 2026-02-23, so the flag reflects a real identifier maturity extraction defect rather than a bad XBRL maturity.
